card.name: Commas and symbols in test statistics
card.fires_on: Punctuation and symbols right after a statistical result, such as the comma after an F value or the equals sign in F (3,39) = . It fires where a p value or further test numbers come next.

modes.label: Comma after statistic
modes.description: The comma that follows an F or similar test value, before the p value.

modes.label: Equals sign or F in a test
modes.description: The F or = symbol inside an F-test report.

card.writes: It suppresses analysis and sensitivity words, so it steers the model away from naming the analysis again after a reported statistic.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a statistics report where the numbers continue, such as after an F value, and not where analysis words would go.
